implementation: reference registry, ledger and example backend of this proposal

base.failureSemantics: every refusal names its reason; nothing proceeds on an unknown or mismatched profile, key context, key epoch, view or policy version
base.tested: ledger and registry by the test suite; backend by its conformance cases

enforcement.action: submit input, request operation, submit result, accept result, request disclosure, approve disclosure
enforcement.by: the ledger, on the answer of the authorizer
threshold shares: every holder of the epoch contributes or nothing is decrypted
admission only: computing on public ciphertexts cannot be prevented; an unadmitted result is not an object
holders contribute only to recorded, standing disclosures, and seal their contribution to the delivery key of the audience

evidence.status: verified by an account other than the executor before acceptance

records.onLedger: requests, approvals, attestations and releases with their accounts and identifiers; commitments of objects
records.completeness: a release outside the recorded path would need every holder to contribute outside it; the ledger cannot show that this did not happen

deployment.roles: each role is a separate operating-system process on one machine, reading its own files only
deployment.limits: no separation by host or network; no proof of well-formed inputs; no proof of correct partial decryption
